about: Main Special Town Meeting post, replacing the 12 Nov draft. The new fact: both articles the School Committee put on the warrant may not reach a vote -- it voted 4 Nov to pass over its special education reserve request, and meets 16 Nov to consider passing over the track engineering article. Board positions from the signed warrant (27 Oct); the 4 Nov pass-over and 10 Nov Capital Planning stance from the recordings; the 16 Nov item from the School Committee agenda. Re-check the track line after the 16 Nov vote, and add Finance Committee positions once its 12 Nov recording is read.
